alarms.action: Stops conveyor motor M-1001 and latches alarm M190 until fault reset (PB-0002, X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam Alarm

alarms.action: Stops conveyor motor M-1001 immediately and sets alarm M191
alarms.name: Motor Overload Alarm

conflicts.program_says: Missing / unprogrammed (timer T10 and photo-eye PE-1002 logic absent from program)

interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately and motor overload alarm (M191) is raised

interlocks.cause: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor is running
interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops and jam alarm (M190) is raised until reset
Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) is inhibited from running in auto mode

steps.entry: Cell in auto mode (SS-0003, X2) with no ST10 fault active and E-stop chain healthy (ES-0001, X0)
steps.exit: Fault condition occurs, auto mode deselected, E-stop tripped, or pallet reaches test position
steps.name: Conveyor Running

steps.entry: Line controller requests release (RQ-1005, X14 rising edge)
steps.exit: Release timer T11 reaches preset (2.0 s elapsed)
steps.name: Stopper Release
